3861: Moka’s Outer form is a tall fair-skinned girl with knee-length pink hair that has bangs swept to the right side, green eyes and full pink lips. As a vampire, Moka has pronounced fangs that allow her to drink blood and her expressions are much softer in this form.
3862: He is an average, ordinary human boy who is somehow accepted into a school of monsters and despite the danger it entails for him, he remains on campus, with one of his motivations for staying being Moka Akashiya.
3863: Kurumu Kurono is a succubus, and is initially jealous of Moka's popularity overshadowing her own, though she eventually considers Moka a friend.
3864: Yukari Sendo is the smartest student at Yokai Academy, and the youngest at age 11 (later 12).
3865: Ginei Morioka nicknamed "Gin" for short, is a werewolf and the president of the Newspaper Club who speaks in an Osakan dialect.
3866: Tsukune's homeroom teacher and Newspaper Club advisor. Her true form is a cat and she loves to eat fish, her favorite fish are the ones from the human world. She has a tendency to say 'meow' in or after sentences.
8129: Mizore Shirayuki is a yuki-onna who is in the same homeroom class as Tsukune and Moka.
8554: A bat who acts like a narrator saying things like how long a battle takes place and occasionally covering up fanservice. It appears in the manga's sequel, Rosario + Vampire II. He seems to be Shuzen Kokoa's servant.
8685: A mysterious, unnamed bus driver who seems to know more than he reveals and constantly shows up to offer advice to Tsukune, he is usually portrayed smoking a cigar. He is the one who requests the board chairman help keep Tsukune's ghoulish nature at bay.
8938: Ruby Tojo is a witch from the human world who was part of a plot to destroy mankind as a response to a large garbage dump polluting her mistress' sanctuary.
9142: Mikogami is a mysterious exorcist who is an old friend of the bus driver (and having the same creepy eyes as the latter) and the headmaster of Yokai Academy.
10508: Ririko Kagome is a bespectacled math teacher at Yokai Academy and a lamia appearing in chapter 12 of the first serialization.
11850: Head of the Student Police Committee, he enforces the group's rules with an iron fist. He is a kitsune, with many fire-based abilities, and can take on a hybrid form between his human and yōkai appearance. from Wikipedia
15055: Kokoa Shuzen is the younger half-sister of Moka Akashiya, sister of Karua Shuzen and stepsister of Akua Shuzen.
17387: Tsukune's conservative and easily shocked mother. She is surprised when her son suddenly comes to visit, after a long time with little to no contact, but is proud of his growing maturity and independence.
17388: Kyouko is Tsukune's 17 year-old cousin. Described as a tomboy with a stubborn streak, she is overprotective of him and makes her appearance on the second day of the school festival while searching for Yōkai Academy.
17701: A beautiful-looking youth who just transferred to Youkai Academy. He has the ability to use his voice to charm people and make them do what he wants them to do, even though the victims are unwilling to.
18158: The physical education teacher at Yokai Academy and a kraken. He is also a way worse pervert than Gin will ever be, as he goes after the female students.
18184: Tsurara is Mizore's mother. Like her daughter, she is very shy and serene, and shares Mizore's habit of hiding behind corners with a lollipop in her mouth. She comes to the Academy's festival under the belief from her daughter's stories that Tsukune is Mizore's boyfriend.
18224: A red-haired member of the Student Police; she appears as a generic member of Student Police in the manga, but her role is expanded in the anime. She is perhaps classified as a _Jiang Shi_.
18413: A typical class bully, Komiya Saizou attempts to rape Moka, but is knocked out by her super-vampire self, and disappears from Yōkai Academy for a while. In his true form, Saizou is an ogre and reappears when Tsukune is elected class president.
18414: Ordered by Kuyou to keep an eye on the Newspaper Club (to make sure it wasn't doing anything the Student Police considered "illegal"), Keito is a spider-woman.
18415: Appearing exclusively in the anime, Apusara-sensei is the Indian cooking teacher of Yōkai Academy and a genie. Her favorite dish is curry and is very passionate about the dish. Unfortunately, the curry takes a side-effect of turning anyone who eats it into a "curry zombie".
18416: Ageha is Kurumu's mother and appears during the start of the school festival under the belief that Tsukune is her daughter's fiancé, going so far as to allow him to "jump" her daughter anytime he wants.
32896: Mako Yakumaru is disquised as a school nurse sent in to assassinate Midou Kusasbi after failing to kill Tsukune. Mako uses Moka against Tsukune and his friends byinjecting her her with a hypnotic fluid to force Moka to kill Tsukune.
33674: She is a mermaid and a president of the Swimming club.
33818: Father of Akuha, Kahlua, Moka, and Kokoa. He is a very influential being among vampires. He makes an appearance in Rosario + Vampire Capu2 as the third Dark Lord.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
81733: A lizardman who is the class representative of Yukari's class. Bearing an intense hatred for witches, he and his cronies often bully Yukari for being one until they were momentarily stopped by Moka.
84027: Lady Oyakata (お館様 Oyakata-sama), referred to Ruby as "My Lady", is a century-old witch that lives on Witch's Knoll and Ruby's guardian.
84035: He is Tsukune Aono's father, Kasumi Aono's husband, and Kyouko Aono's uncle.
84037: Lilith is a small fairy (a tsukumogami or artifact spirit) who carries the Lilith Mirror (リリスの鏡 Ririsu no Kagami), an object allowing whoever holds it to see a monster's true form as well as their hidden desires, but at the cost of the user's soul.
